# The Brood-Forge (doc 47, doc 59).

# Kobold Biology is done and the kobold heritage is active: Strain, Essence and the Brood-Forge are on.
DA_KB_on = {
	DA_RH_active_kobold = yes
	has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Biology
}
# A Dragon Cult country (Anbennar's religion kobold_dragon_cult): the Hoard Offering also feeds the Hoard.
DA_KB_cult = {
	religion = kobold_dragon_cult
}
# No new part while Strain is Critical (doc 47, section 3).
DA_KB_not_critical = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_not_critical_tt
		NOT = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_band value = 3 } }
	}
}
# Hatcheries: its price, paid when it starts.
DA_KB_has_hatchery_price = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_hatchery_price_tt
		check_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 10 }
	}
}

# One path per part: a Brass tile closes the part's Blood tiles, and back (its first tile, done or under way),
# until Chimera Theory opens both.
DA_KB_path_open.Claws_Brass = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_path_open_tt.Claws_Brass
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Chimera
			AND = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood1 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_KB_Claws_Blood1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# The price of each part's tile (kobold_data.PRICE), at the Council's discount, the aspect's, or in full.
DA_KB_price.KB_Claws_Brass1 = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_price_tt.KB_Claws_Brass1
		OR = {
			AND = {
				DA_KB_council_disc.Claws_Brass = yes
				treasury = 150
				check_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 8 }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { DA_KB_council_disc.Claws_Brass = yes }
				DA_KB_aspect_disc.Claws_Brass = yes
				treasury = 180
				check_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 9 }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { DA_KB_council_disc.Claws_Brass = yes }
				NOT = { DA_KB_aspect_disc.Claws_Brass = yes }
				treasury = 200
				check_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 10 }
			}
		}
	}
}

			AND = {
				DA_KB_council_disc.Bones_Blood = yes
				treasury = 300
				check_variable = { which = DA_KB_essence value = 9 }
				check_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 4 }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { DA_KB_council_disc.Bones_Blood = yes }
				DA_KB_aspect_disc.Bones_Blood = yes
				treasury = 360
				check_variable = { which = DA_KB_essence value = 11 }
				check_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 5 }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { DA_KB_council_disc.Bones_Blood = yes }
				NOT = { DA_KB_aspect_disc.Bones_Blood = yes }
				treasury = 400
				check_variable = { which = DA_KB_essence value = 12 }
				check_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 5 }

# How many parts are done in a path and tier (Ascension and the ruler marks).

	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_has_parts_tt.blood1_4
		calc_true_if = { amount = 4 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood1 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Scales_Blood1 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Bones_Blood1 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Wings_Blood1 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Fire_Blood1 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Heart_Blood1 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Mind_Blood1 }
	}
}

# The Molt: the Cult's Hoard at level 6, or 3000 ducats from a kobold country outside the Cult.
DA_KB_molt_price = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_molt_price_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				DA_KB_cult = yes
				REB = { check_variable = { which = dragon_cult_hoard value = 8000 } }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { DA_KB_cult = yes }
				treasury = 3000
			}
		}
	}
}
# Step 4: Nimrith's Offspring hears the dragon-priests of a Dragon Cult kobold country (the Parley of the Legendary
# Encounter window, le_rules.py); the Hunter of the Deeps lets a kobold country of the Purple Dragon kneel.
DA_KB_can_parley_dragon = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_can_parley_dragon_tt
		DA_KB_on = yes
		DA_KB_cult = yes
	}
}
DA_KB_can_kneel = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_can_kneel_tt
		DA_KB_on = yes
		OR = {
			has_church_aspect = purple_dragon_1_base
			has_church_aspect = purple_dragon_1_upgraded
			has_church_aspect = purple_dragon_2_base
			has_church_aspect = purple_dragon_2_upgraded
			has_church_aspect = purple_dragon_3_base
			has_church_aspect = purple_dragon_3_upgraded
		}
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_kneel_clock_tt
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_KB_hunter_blessing }
	}
}
# The designer paths (step 3): four parts of the path, while the kobold heritage is active.

	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_designer_tt.Blood
		DA_KB_on = yes
		DA_KB_has_parts.blood1_4 = yes
	}
}
DA_KB_designer.Brass = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_designer_tt.Brass
		DA_KB_on = yes
		DA_KB_has_parts.brass1_4 = yes
	}
}

# The works of the Brood-Forge.
DA_KB_can_clutch = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_clutch_needs_tt
		has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Hatcheries
	}
	treasury = 200
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_clutch_clock_tt
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_clutch_blessed }
			had_country_flag = { flag = DA_KB_clutch_blessed days = 1825 }
		}
	}
}
DA_KB_can_offer = {
	treasury = 500
}
DA_KB_can_distil = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_distil_price_tt
		check_variable = { which = DA_KB_essence value = 5 }
	}
}

# ---- Step 2 (doc 60): the new works ----
DA_KB_can_moot = {
	treasury = 300
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_moot_price_tt
		check_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 5 }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_moot_clock_tt
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_moot_held }
			had_country_flag = { flag = DA_KB_moot_held days = 3650 }
		}
	}
}
DA_KB_can_council = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_cult_tt
		DA_KB_cult = yes
	}
	treasury = 100
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_council_clock_tt
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_council_held }
			had_country_flag = { flag = DA_KB_council_held days = 3650 }
		}
	}
}
# A part can be excised when it has a done tile and none of its tiles is under way.
DA_KB_can_excise.Claws = {
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Brass1
		has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Brass2
		has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood1
		has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood2
	}
	NOT = {
		has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_KB_Claws_Brass1
		has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_KB_Claws_Brass2
		has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_KB_Claws_Blood1

# ---- The inventions of the Brood-Forge (doc 67) ----
# What switching one on needs: the kobold heritage active with Kobold Biology, the Artificers estate, artificery.
DA_KB_inv_allowed = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_inv_heritage_tt
		DA_KB_on = yes
	}
	has_estate = estate_artificers
	DA_SS_artificery_available = yes
}
# The forge makes one invention at a time.
DA_KB_forge_free = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_forge_free_tt
		NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_forging }
	}
}
# Trap-Engines (Brass, tier I)
DA_KB_inv_open.traps = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_inv_open_tt.traps
		DA_PR_done.KB_Biology = yes
	}
}
DA_KB_inv_st_forging.traps = {
	has_country_flag = DA_KB_forging
	is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_forge_job value = 1 }
}
DA_KB_can_forge.traps = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_inv_heritage_tt
		DA_KB_on = yes
	}
	DA_KB_inv_open.traps = yes
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_not_forged_tt.Brass
		NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_forged.traps }
	}
	DA_KB_forge_free = yes
	treasury = 150
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_inv_price_tt.traps
		check_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 10 }
	}
}
DA_KB_can_on.traps = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_forged_tt.Brass
		has_country_flag = DA_KB_forged.traps
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_is_off_tt
		NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.traps }
	}
	DA_KB_inv_allowed = yes
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_switch_cd_tt
		DA_SS_cooldown_finished = { flag = DA_KB_inv_switch.traps days = 365 }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_room_tt.10
		check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 10 }
	}
}
DA_KB_can_off.traps = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_KB_is_on_tt
		has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.traps
	}
}
